links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified Circulation cardiology research abstracts
links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FKRE), word and character counts, and physician and layperson ratings of understandability
links.effect: Word and character counts fell significantly (p<0.0001). Readability improved from a college graduate level to an 8th-9th grade level (p<0.001), even though the target was 5th grade. Physicians and laypeople both found the simplified abstracts easier to understand (113 abstracts).
links.tradeoff: Some laypeople were concerned about oversimplification and missing details. The authors say further refinement is needed to ensure accuracy.
links.quote: The simplification significantly reduced word and character counts (p<0.0001) and improved readability from a college graduate level to an 8th-9th grade level (p<0.001).

design_hint: reading-level constraint in prompt with clinician and lay review
